build_gcs_path_suggestion: build a GCS directory path suggestion for a given project name with timestamp
validate_gcs_path: validate whether a path is a valid GCS URL in gs:// or /gcs/ format
convert_gcs_path_formats: convert between gs:// bucket URLs and /gcs/ FUSE mount paths
generate_gcs_console_url: generate a GCP console browser URL from a GCS path for web access
retrieve_gcs_flag_or_fail: retrieve the --xm_gcs_path flag value or raise an error with a suggestion
